<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Some were big enough to crash through planets, while others were “merely” the size of cities.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|— ''The Captain'', chapter 32}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Behemoth Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Behemoths are colossal entities characterized by their massive [[scale]], ranging from the size of cities to beings capable of destroying planets. These creatures are defined by a fusion of organic matter and cybernetic components, often constructed from reanimated organisms such as contrasaurs. They possess a natural resistance to magic and maintain a unique relationship with [[Subspace]], which they may navigate by swimming, hopping, or warping the dimension around them. Physically, they can feature starship-grade armor, camera-like eyes capable of extreme magnification, and specialized weaponry like missile swarms or claws. In combat and utility, Behemoths serve as powerful assets for the [[Iron Legion]]. They are specifically designed to detect and neutralize large-[[scale]] magical activity, making them effective tools for suppressing mages or disrupting complex rituals. While they can be used as precision instruments to capture targets, their immense size and instinctual nature often make them more suited for overwhelming [[destruction]]. Some notable examples include [[Neth’terith]], a moon-sized beetle capable of impaling continents, which is classified as one of the [[Seven Calamities]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|This hulking beast is composed of both flesh and metal, featuring city-sized armored plates. Depending on the specific model, they may possess limbs woven from meat and machine, building-sized camera eyes, and starship armor. Their massive [[scale]] ranges from the size of cities to creatures large enough to crash through planets.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Raion Raithe|Raion]] has engaged in combat with the Behemoth. This individual previously fought the creature and also went all-out against it.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|These creatures possess a resistance to magic and the ability to interact with [[Subspace]]. They are powerful enough to fight a [[Divine Titan]] in hand-to-hand combat.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Captain}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Behemoth is a hulking beast composed of metal and flesh that features city-sized armored plates, though it can be defeated if five [[Divine Titans]] combine their strength.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c31">''The Captain'', chapter 31</ref> As a trump card for the [[Iron Legion]], these creatures are constructed in shipyards using staggering amounts of resources and cyborg components like digital brain-[[chips]] and metal skeletons.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32">''The Captain'', chapter 32</ref> Most bodies are formed from astral megafauna or scavenged dreadnoughts, and they possess cybernetic pieces, magic resistance, and the ability to interact with [[Subspace]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32" /> While their sizes vary from city-[[scale]] to being large enough to crash through planets, a Behemoth made from a [[contrasaur]] specifically features starship armor, building-sized camera eyes, and limbs woven from meat and machine.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c32" /> These entities are capable of fighting a [[Divine Titan]] fist-to-fist, and there are perhaps only ten in existence throughout the galaxy.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c33">''The Captain'', chapter 33</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c34">''The Captain'', chapter 34</ref> During various conflicts, [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] went all-out against a Behemoth, and an insectoid variant was once seen hunting the [[Galactic Union fleet]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c39">''The Captain'', chapter 39</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c44">''The Captain'', chapter 44</ref>}}
